owner: dotfiles-runtime daemon run (the hub, sole emitter)

versioning.non_breaking: additive method | signal | topic | optional field stays on org.dotfiles.Events1
versioning.coexistence: Events1 and Events2 may coexist on the bus under distinct interface names during migration

delivery.ordering: per-topic monotonic seq (u) within an epoch (u); the epoch bumps on hub restart and resets seq
delivery.hydration: subscribe-then-read GetTopicState/GetActiveJobs; GetTopicState returns reserved _epoch (u) and _seq (u); drop signals whose (epoch, seq) is not greater than hydrated

capture.state.notes: started_at is unix seconds (0 when idle); the timer is rendered from it, never read from a file
